query:
SELECT 
            input.c_type as "content_type!", 
            input.c_id as "content_id!", 
            COUNT(l.id) as "count!"
        FROM 
            UNNEST($1::text[], $2::uuid[]) AS input(c_type, c_id)
        LEFT JOIN 
            likes l ON l.content_type = input.c_type AND l.content_id = input.c_id
        GROUP BY 
            input.c_type, input.c_id
